Product Description

The 4.5" raised seat is built around security: two independent locks keep it from shifting or loosening during use. It suits short-term recovery and anyone who needs a taller seat at a sensible cost. Weight-bearing support arms are included. Seat weight limit: 300 lbs.
  • Adjustable mounting base fits both round & elongated toilets
  • Support arms included, tested to 200 lbs. each side
  • Elongated ring opening for hygiene access and comfort
  • Smooth, glossy surface that cleans easily
  • Unlocks from the base for cleaning
